label.en: General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places
General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places
General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places
General for Garrisoning Fengtian and Other Places

units.zh: 康熙元年壬寅，設鎭守遼東等處將軍、鎭守寧古塔等處將軍。
units.en: In Kangxi 1 (1662), year renyin, the posts of General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places and General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places were created.
units.literal: Kangxi 1st year, year renyin: the General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places and the General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places were established.

units.zh: 吳達禮自鎭守盛京昂邦將軍爲鎭守遼東等處將軍。
units.en: Wu Dali was transferred from Angbang General at Shengjing to General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places.
units.literal: Wu Dali, from Angbang General garrisoning Shengjing, became General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places.

units.zh: 巴海順治十六年以昂邦將軍駐防，是年陞鎭守寧古塔等處將軍。
units.en: Bahai had garrisoned as Angbang General since Shunzhi 16; this year he was promoted to General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places.
units.literal: Bahai, from Shunzhi 16 as Angbang General on garrison duty, was this year promoted to General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places.

units.zh: 吳達禮五月辛巳，達都鎭守遼東等處將軍。六月己未改鎭守奉天等處將軍。
units.en: On day xinsi in the fifth month, Dadu was made General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places; on day jiwei in the sixth month the title was changed to General for Garrisoning Fengtian and Other Places.
units.literal: On day xinsi in the fifth month, Dadu was made General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places; on day jiwei in the sixth month the title was changed to General for Garrisoning Fengtian and Other Places.

units.zh: 達都九月庚子吳瑪護爲奉天將軍。
units.en: On day gengzi in the ninth month, Wu Mahu was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: On day gengzi in the ninth month, Wu Mahu was appointed Fengtian General.

units.zh: 吳瑪護六月己酉阿穆爾圖爲奉天將軍。
units.en: On day jiyou in the sixth month, Amurtu was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: On day jiyou in the sixth month, Amurtu was appointed Fengtian General.

units.zh: 阿穆爾圖卒，予祭葬。十二月乙丑倭內以正黃旗副都統爲奉天將軍。
units.en: Amurtu died and was given sacrificial and burial honors. On the yichou day of the twelfth month, Wonei, as lieutenant general of the Plain Yellow Banner, became Fengtian General.
units.literal: Amurtu died and was given sacrificial and burial honors. On the yichou day of the twelfth month, Wonei, as lieutenant general of the Plain Yellow Banner, became Fengtian General.

units.zh: 倭內七月甲寅解任。安珠瑚爲奉天將軍。
units.en: On the jiayin day of the seventh month, Wonei was relieved of office. Anzhuhu became Fengtian General.
units.literal: On the jiayin day of the seventh month, Wonei was relieved of office. Anzhuhu became Fengtian General.

units.zh: 康熙二十二年癸亥，九月設黑龍江將軍。
units.en: Kangxi 22 (1683), year guihai: in the ninth month the post of Heilongjiang General was created.
units.literal: Kangxi 22nd year, year guihai; ninth month: Heilongjiang General was established.

units.en: In the first month, on day xinsi, he was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: First month, day xinsi: made Fengtian General.

units.zh: 巴海罷。八月庚子，殷圖爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: Bahai was removed from office. On the gengzi day of the eighth month, Yintu became Ningguta General.
units.literal: Bahai was removed from office. On the gengzi day of the eighth month, Yintu became Ningguta General.

units.zh: 十月癸亥爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: In the tenth month, on day guihai, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: Tenth month, day guihai: made Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 十一月辛未遷。貝勒十二月庚寅爲奉天將軍。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on day xinwei, he was transferred. In the twelfth month, on day gengyin, a beile was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day xinwei: transferred. A beile, twelfth month, day gengyin: made Fengtian General.

units.zh: 九月卒。十月庚戌爲奉天將軍。
units.en: He died in the ninth month. In the tenth month, on day gengxu, another officer was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: Ninth month: died. Tenth month, day gengxu: made Fengtian General.

units.zh: 殷圖五月壬戌革。乙亥，佟保爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: On the renxu day of the fifth month, Yintu was dismissed. On the yihai day, Tongbao became Ningguta General.
units.literal: On the renxu day of the fifth month, Yintu was dismissed. On the yihai day, Tongbao became Ningguta General.

units.en: Sabusu moved his seat to Mergen.
units.literal: Sabusu moved his headquarters to Mergen.

units.zh: 費揚古爲安北將軍，駐歸化城。
units.en: Fiyanggu was made Anbei General, stationed at Guihuacheng.
units.literal: Fiyanggu became Anbei General, garrisoned at Guihuacheng.

units.zh: 十月授右衛將軍，仍兼管歸化城將軍事。
units.en: In the tenth month he was appointed General of the Right Guard while still concurrently overseeing the duties of the Guihuacheng general.
units.literal: Tenth month: appointed Youwei General, still concurrently managing the affairs of the Guihuacheng General.

units.zh: 六月癸丑革。七月己巳爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: In the sixth month, on day guichou, he was dismissed; in the seventh month, on day jisi, he was appointed Ningguta General.
units.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: dismissed. Seventh month, day jisi: made Ningguta General.

units.zh: 四月戊午革。四月壬午爲奉天將軍。
units.en: In the fourth month, on day wuwu, he was dismissed; on day renwu he was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: Fourth month, day wuwu: dismissed. Fourth month, day renwu: made Fengtian General.

units.en: Sabusu moved his seat to Qiqihar.
units.literal: Sabusu moved his headquarters to Qiqihar.

units.zh: 沙那海二月乙丑遷。楊福爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: On the yichou day of the second month, Shanahai was transferred. Yang Fu became Ningguta General.
units.literal: On the yichou day of the second month, Shanahai was transferred. Yang Fu became Ningguta General.

units.zh: 薩布素二月己未革。沙那海爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: On the jiwei day of the second month, Sabusu was dismissed. Shanahai became Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: On the jiwei day of the second month, Sabusu was dismissed. Shanahai became Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 沙那海七月丁巳休致。博定八月丁亥爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: On day dingsi in the seventh month, Shanahai retired; on day dinghai in the eighth month, Boding was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: On day dingsi in the seventh month, Shanahai retired; on day dinghai in the eighth month, Boding was appointed Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 蘇努免。蒙俄洛正月癸酉爲奉天將軍。
units.en: Sunu was dismissed; on day guiyou in the first month, Meng'eluo was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: Sunu was dismissed; on day guiyou in the first month, Meng'eluo was appointed Fengtian General.

units.zh: 博定九月庚寅遷。法都十一月丙申爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: On day gengyin in the ninth month, Boding was transferred; on day bingshen in the eleventh month, Fadu was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: On day gengyin in the ninth month, Boding was transferred; on day bingshen in the eleventh month, Fadu was appointed Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 蒙俄洛二月己酉遷。嵩祝二月戊午署奉天將軍。
units.en: On day jiyou in the second month, Meng'eluo was transferred; on day wuwu, Songzhu was appointed acting Fengtian General.
units.literal: On day jiyou in the second month, Meng'eluo was transferred; on day wuwu, Songzhu was appointed acting Fengtian General.

units.zh: 楊福二月己酉遷。蒙俄洛二月己酉爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: On day jiyou in the second month, Yang Fu was transferred and Meng'eluo was appointed Ningguta General.
units.literal: On day jiyou in the second month, Yang Fu was transferred and Meng'eluo was appointed Ningguta General.

units.zh: 法都二月乙巳革。楊福二月己酉爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: On day yisi in the second month, Fadu was dismissed; on day jiyou, Yang Fu was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: On day yisi in the second month, Fadu was dismissed; on day jiyou, Yang Fu was appointed Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 嵩祝十月丁巳遷。唐保柱十月丁巳署奉天將軍。
units.en: On day dingsi in the tenth month, Songzhu was transferred and Tangbaozhu was appointed acting Fengtian General.
units.literal: On day dingsi in the tenth month, Songzhu was transferred and Tangbaozhu was appointed acting Fengtian General.

units.zh: 蒙俄洛卒。穆森三月辛丑署寧古塔將軍。
units.en: Meng'eluo died; on day xinchou in the third month, Musen was appointed acting Ningguta General.
units.literal: Meng'eluo died; on day xinchou in the third month, Musen was appointed acting Ningguta General.

units.zh: 楊福卒。五月丙午，三官保署黑龍江將軍。
units.en: Yang Fu died. On the bingwu day of the fifth month, Sanguanbao acted as Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: Yang Fu died. On the bingwu day of the fifth month, Sanguanbao acted as Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 十月戊子爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: In the tenth month, on day wuzi, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: Tenth month, day wuzi: made Heilongjiang General.

units.en: In the seventh month he was appointed acting Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 正月乙亥乞休。三月爲右衛將軍。
units.en: In the first month, on day yihai, he asked to retire; in the third month he was appointed General of the Right Guard.
units.literal: First month, day yihai: requested retirement. Third month: made Youwei General.
Basai served as acting Ningguta General.

units.en: In the second month, on day jiazi, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Heilongjiang General.
Minister for Managing Affairs in Tibet

units.zh: 唐保柱十二月癸未解任。綽奇爲奉天將軍。
units.en: On the guiwei day of the twelfth month, Tangbaozhu was relieved of office. Chuoqi became Fengtian General.
units.literal: On the guiwei day of the twelfth month, Tangbaozhu was relieved of office. Chuoqi became Fengtian General.

units.zh: 巴賽二月丁未召。哈達寧古塔將軍。
units.en: On the dingwei day of the second month, Basai was summoned. Hada: Ningguta General.
units.literal: On the dingwei day of the second month, Basai was summoned. Hada: Ningguta General.

units.zh: 顔壽六月戊子降。吳札布爲右衛將軍。
units.en: On the wuzi day of the sixth month, Yanshou was demoted. Wu Zhabu became General of the Right Guard.
units.literal: On the wuzi day of the sixth month, Yanshou was demoted. Wu Zhabu became General of the Right Guard.

units.zh: 綽奇十一月遷。噶爾弼奉天將軍。
units.en: In the eleventh month, Chuoqi was transferred. Ga'erbi: Fengtian General.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Chuoqi was transferred. Ga'erbi: Fengtian General.

units.en: Danai was assigned to manage Qinghai affairs.

units.zh: 陳泰二月召。傅爾丹爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: In the second month, Chen Tai was summoned. Fuerdaan became Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: In the second month, Chen Tai was summoned. Fuerdaan became Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 吳札布二月遷。申穆德爲右衛將軍。
units.en: In the second month, Wu Zhabu was transferred. Shenmude became Right Guard General.
units.literal: In the second month, Wu Zhabu was transferred. Shenmude became Right Guard General.

units.zh: 噶爾弼二月卒。伊札布閏三月爲奉天將軍。
units.en: Ga'erbi died in the second month; in the intercalary third month, Yi Zhabu was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: Ga'erbi died in the second month; in the intercalary third month, Yi Zhabu was appointed Fengtian General.

units.zh: 傅爾丹二月召。那蘇圖十二月爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: In the second month, Fuerdaan was summoned; in the twelfth month, Nasutu was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: In the second month, Fuerdaan was summoned; in the twelfth month, Nasutu was appointed Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 僧格五月丁巳赴藏辦事。瑪臘正月丁巳赴藏辦事。
units.en: On day dingsi in the fifth month, Sengge went to Tibet on official business; on day dingsi in the first month, Mala went to Tibet on official business.
units.literal: On day dingsi in the fifth month, Sengge went to Tibet to manage affairs; on day dingsi in the first month, Mala went to Tibet to manage affairs.

units.zh: 伊札布九月癸亥免。武格署。
units.en: On the guihai day of the ninth month, Yi Zhabu was removed from office. Wuge served in an acting capacity.
units.literal: On the guihai day of the ninth month, Yi Zhabu was removed from office. Wuge served in an acting capacity.

units.zh: 武格二月遷。多索禮爲奉天將軍。
units.en: In the second month, Wuge was transferred. Duosuoli became Fengtian General.
units.literal: In the second month, Wuge was transferred. Duosuoli became Fengtian General.

units.zh: 多索禮正月降。那蘇圖爲奉天將軍。
units.en: In the first month, Duosuoli was demoted. Nasutu became Fengtian General.
units.literal: In the first month, Duosuoli was demoted. Nasutu became Fengtian General.

units.zh: 那蘇圖正月遷。卓爾海爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: In the first month, Nasutu was transferred. Zhuo'erhai became Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: In the first month, Nasutu was transferred. Zhuo'erhai became Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 僧格回京。青保駐藏辦事。瑪臘
units.en: Sengge returned to the capital. Qingbao served as resident minister in Tibet. Mala.
units.literal: Sengge returned to the capital. Qingbao was stationed in Tibet handling affairs. Mala.

units.zh: 哈達正月遷。常德爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: In the first month, Hada was transferred. Changde became Ningguta General.
units.literal: In the first month, Hada was transferred. Changde became Ningguta General.

units.zh: 青保瑪臘六月召回京。苗壽駐藏辦事。
units.en: In the sixth month, Qingbao and Mala were summoned back to the capital. Miaoshou: Resident Minister in Tibet.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Qingbao and Mala were summoned back to the capital. Miaoshou: Resident Minister in Tibet.

units.zh: 常德九月赴軍營。杜賚署。
units.en: In the ninth month, Changde went to the military camp. Dulai served in an acting capacity.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Changde went to the military camp. Dulai served in an acting capacity.

units.zh: 卓爾海九月遷。塔爾岱爲寧古塔將軍。
units.en: In the ninth month, Zhuo'erhai was transferred. Ta'erdai became Ningguta General.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Zhuo'erhai was transferred. Ta'erdai became Ningguta General.

units.en: Celing was made Dingbian Left Vice General.
units.literal: Celing became Dingbian Left Vice General.

units.zh: 德齡八月總理青海番人事務。
units.en: In the eighth month, Deling was placed in overall charge of Tibetan affairs in Qinghai.
units.literal: In the eighth month, Deling was placed in overall charge of Tibetan affairs in Qinghai.

units.zh: 青保苗壽召回京。阿爾珣八月赴藏辦事。尋卒。那蘇泰赴藏辦事。
units.en: Qingbao and Miaoshou were recalled to the capital. In the eighth month, A'erxun went to Tibet on official business and soon died. Nasutai went to Tibet on official business.
units.literal: Qingbao and Miaoshou were recalled to the capital. In the eighth month, A'erxun went to Tibet to manage affairs and soon died. Nasutai went to Tibet to manage affairs.

units.zh: 那蘇圖遷。覺羅柏修爲奉天將軍。
units.en: Nasutu was transferred. Jueluo Baixiu was appointed Fengtian General.
units.literal: Nasutu was transferred. Jueluo Baixiu was appointed Fengtian General.

units.zh: 塔爾岱遷。那蘇圖爲黑龍江將軍。
units.en: Ta'erdai was transferred. Nasutu was appointed Heilongjiang General.
units.literal: Ta'erdai was transferred. Nasutu was appointed Heilongjiang General.

units.zh: 申穆德免。十二月岱林布右衛將軍。
units.en: Shenmude was removed from office. In the twelfth month, Dailinbu: Right Guard General.
units.literal: Shenmude was removed from office. In the twelfth month, Dailinbu: Right Guard General.
